description:
350W Brushless Motor: Electric scooter comes with high power brushless motor, provides a maximum speed of 19 MPH, 15% uphill climb keep you motivated when going uphill.

Large Capacity Battery: Adult electric scooter has a large llithium-ion battery, built-in intelligent BMS system, which has fast charging function as well, it supports fast charging and can travel about 15 miles on a single 4-5 hours charge.

Easy to Store & Carry: E scooter can be folded in just 3 seconds for compact storage in car trunks, closets, or tight spaces. Foldable electric scooter lightweight design making it effortless to carry anywhere.

Keep Your Comfort & Safety: This fast electric scooter features 8.5-inch puncture-resistant honeycomb tires for excellent shock absorption and comfort, requiring no inflation or maintenance. The sturdy aluminum alloy frame ensures longevity, while the pedal battery compartment features precision iron full-weld construction, supporting up to 264 lbs. Safety features include a bell, front headlight, rear taillight, and dual braking system.

Quality Assurance: VOLPAM pursues excellent performance and quality products for the users. 12-month or 180-day for different parts, please contact us if you have any questions.
